name: crypto-perps/retail-crowding-xs
title: Retail crowding, cross-sectional — contrarian Binance L/S account ratio on spot
description: Each day ranks the point-in-time top-20 liquid coins (of the 64 PERP_OF tickers) by Binance's USDT-perp global long/short ACCOUNT ratio (the retail head count, last 5-min value before 23:00 UTC); shorts the 30 % where retail is most net long, longs the 30 % where it is least, 0.5 gross per side, legs rescaled beta-neutral to BTC (EWM-60), held as the mean of the last 7 daily books. Traded on spot closes, not perps.
direction: long/short (beta-neutral to BTC; net dollar exposure ~+0.04 average)

backtest.cost_type: 10 bp per side on sum|dw|; short-leg borrow/funding carry NOT modelled

benchmark.name: long BTC+ETH / short EW alts, beta-neutral (majors-vs-alts tilt)

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the yfinance daily close from the shared data/ cache -- no order book, no rejection, no partial fill. Weaker evidence than a venue fill; do not read this track as exchange-cleared. The book has a short leg, so the venue book was never an option.

Cost: fee 10 bp + slippage 0 bp = the research's 10 bp/side on turnover (30.7x/yr). Report ladder: 20 bp -> 1.05 full, 30 bp -> 0.86 full. broker_from_meta (dashboard flatten) rebuilds with library default slippage; affects a one-off flatten only.
UNMODELLED short-leg carry (borrow / perp funding) on ~0.49 short notional; the sim ledger charges none, so the live curve flatters a real one by that amount.

Data feeds refreshed on every run: yfinance daily bars (64 legs); Binance USD-M metrics archive data/<SYM>_metrics_5m.parquet via metrics_panel.fetch (1-day publication lag; perps silent > 30 days -- WAVES, XEM, OMG, MKR, EOS -- are treated as delisted and not re-polled); REST globalLongShortAccountRatio via metrics_panel.fetch_rest (re-stamped -5 min) for the days the archive has not published. Archive wins on overlap; a hole between the two drops REST for that perp (it then goes ineligible for the day). Fewer than 10 perps with a ratio on the decision bar raises and the day is retried.

Timing: every input truncated to rows before the current UTC day; weight from the last complete bar D using ratio stamps < D 23:00 UTC, applied to D+1 (backtest_xs convention). Daemon wakes 00:30 UTC.

Deploy check 2026-09-30 00:23 UTC on decision bar 2026-09-29: runner weights == strategy.target_weights on the runner's stitched ratio panel, max|diff| 0.0; gross 1.000, net +0.102, 9 long / 8 short, 59 perps with a ratio. Research path (archive only) agrees to 0.0 on every date through 2026-09-28; on 09-29 the archive holds only 23:00-23:55 of 09-28, which the REST stitch replaces. exp04_weights.parquet stores the UNSHIFTED decision-at-close-D weight (lag 0, max|diff| 2.7e-3, mean 8.9e-5 -- yfinance cache revisions since the research run).

Caveats from the report: 4.5-year sample (alt archive starts 2021-12), DSR 0.65 at N=57; ~60 % of OOS is a static coin tilt (persistently long TRX/BTC/BCH, short DOGE/ADA/XRP/SHIB); TRX-dependent (ex-TRX 1.01 full); only the raw level works (selection-free ensemble 0.80/0.61 OOS). Daily rho 0.05 with live crypto-alts/alt-sleeve-blend.

Stalled-book failure mode: SimPortfolioBroker.bar_key is the minimum bar across all 64 legs, so if Yahoo stops serving any one (OMG, XEM, ONE are near-dead) the book stops advancing. Drop the stale ticker from TRADED if that happens.
